_comment: Authoritative destructible arena props (#71), read by the server and clients through ArenaProps. Changing any value is a gameplay change: bump WireCodec.BUILD and ship a matching hosted server release. kinds: which arena obstacles break (by obstacle kind and name prefix) and their HP. A broken prop loses its collider on every peer until the next round.

kinds._maelstrom: Frozen Maelstrom (#102): seracs (the big ice obstacles), icicle clusters, barrels, crates, standing masts and the capsized keel's ribs. shatter: bots never collide with them; they break the moment a bot reaches them (and still take weapon damage). break_speed: the big ones (seracs, masts, ribs) only break when rammed at least this fast (m/s closing speed, scaled by bot mass over ram.reference_mass); a gentler bot hits them like a wall.
kinds._elysium: Elysium (#115): marble columns (each with its stretch of entablature), arch piers and attics, obelisks, broken columns, balustrade runs and the rotunda's gilded dome. The big pieces stay solid for slow bots and burst when rammed hard enough (break_speed, ~m/s for a 90 kg bot: a flat-out fast bot bursts a column, a pier takes a heavy nitro ram); a balustrade gives way to any real ram, so it only guards a careful driver. An attic falls when a pier under it breaks, the dome once four of the rotunda's columns are gone (ArenaProps supports).

multipliers._comment: Weapon kind -> prop kind -> damage multiplier (unlisted = 1). Saws and grinders fell timber; guns barely chip granite. Marble (Elysium) cracks under hammers and shells, shrugs off fire and bullets.

melee._comment: Weapon contact with props, keyed by weapon (Atlas front tools by tool: grinder, ram, spear). The tool reaches a sphere of reach (m, before geometry scale) ahead of the hull. dps: continuous damage while the weapon runs (saw, grinder at full spin); hit: one blow per strike or per cooldown seconds (spinners).

ram._comment: A bot driving into a prop above min_closing_speed (m/s) deals damage_per_speed per m/s over it, scaled by the bot's mass over reference_mass, once per cooldown seconds per prop.
